kjv: for in the thing wherein they (the Egyptians) dealt proudly he (Yahweh) was above them (the Egyptians)
mine: because of what happened when they (the Egyptians) acted arrogantly against the people
note: The Hebrew ki baddavar 'asher zadu 'aleihem is elliptical, with no main verb. The KJV adds "he was above them". I take it as referring to Egypt's arrogance and what befell them.
